statement: The ask path of act/prompt.mjs now tries a direct table first and the knowledge tier before any model cell. On the 200 held-out first-sentence facts of the knowledge bar's draw (seed knowledge-draw-2026-09-23), asked through ask() with the model cell offline, 122 were answered correctly at recall@1 with provenance memory or direct and no model call (61.0%, the bar is 100); 175 came from the direct table in one lookup, and 175 of those 175 gave the answer the tier alone gave. The same questions scored 122 with the tier alone, 122 with a control table that holds every title but the drawn ones (0 direct hits), 0 with the tier and the table off, and 18 when the answer is the title's own last word. The table memoises the tier: it was filled by asking the tier "What is <title>?" for 3000 titles, the drawn titles among them, and none of the hidden sentences was ever in the store. Native answers took a mean 38.3 microseconds a whole ask with the table on and 1061.2 with the tier alone. Over 100000 lookups a run the table took a median 9.24 ns a hit and 11.93 ns a miss, measured with process.hrtime.bigint on a shared machine. The tasks suites scored 724 of 725 before and 724 of 725 after, and of the 724 suite questions ask() answered exactly and correctly before the change, 0 were lost with the table off and 0 with it on. The semantic tier is now bounded by a declared 256 MB byte budget, room for 15416 named keys, instead of 4,096 keys.
